ingameblocks.kind_help.cube: A normal block. One picture on all sides, or a different one on every side.
ingameblocks.kind_help.pillar: Turns like a log. Top/bottom faces are the ends.
ingameblocks.kind_help.glass: See-through block: transparent pixels stay transparent.
ingameblocks.kind_help.slab: Half block. Two slabs of the same design make a full block.
ingameblocks.kind_help.stairs: Stairs with corners, like vanilla ones.
ingameblocks.kind_help.fence: Connects to other fences and solid blocks.
ingameblocks.kind_help.carpet: Thin layer on the floor. Uses the top picture.
ingameblocks.kind_help.plant: Cross-shaped plant like grass or flowers. No collision. Draw it on a transparent background!
ingameblocks.kind.head: Head
ingameblocks.kind_help.head: Small 8×8×8 block that can be worn on the head.
ingameblocks.kind_help.anvil: A working anvil that never breaks. Top face = the top of the anvil.
ingameblocks.kind_help.piston: Looks like a piston and faces you when placed, but does not push.
ingameblocks.error.is_webp: WebP picture that could not be read
ingameblocks.error.is_ico: this is an .ico icon, not a picture
ingameblocks.error.is_html: this is a web page saved as .png, not a picture
ingameblocks.error.unreadable: the file could not be read
ingameblocks.error.bad_id: id may only use a-z, 0-9, _ and -
ingameblocks.error.id_taken: another block already uses this id
ingameblocks.error.not_block_zip: this .zip is not an exported InGameBlocks block

Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y: undo / redo
